title: Filipino Halo Halo
description: A Filipino dessert made with shaved ice and various sweetened beans, fruits, and milk. This version adds a creative twist with warm, molten, and passata.

ingredients.name: Halo halo toppings (various fruits and nuts)

instructions: In a tall glass, add the shaved ice.
Top the ice with the sweetened red and green beans, young coconut meat, and pinipig.
Pour the warm milk over the top of the dessert.
Melt the molten chocolate in a double boiler and drizzle over the top of the dessert.
Pour the passata over the dessert, creating a layered effect.
Garnish with halo halo toppings, such as beans, fruits, and nuts.
